title: Maodun Unauthorised Installation
excerpt: An Unauthorised Installation may be found in orbit of Maodun, in the Isinor system. Please note that as Isinor is Permit Locked, you will need to gain reputation with the The Chapter of Isinor and be offered a permit acquisition opportunity (which can occur at Malerba Orbital in Anotchadiae) before being able to visit.
